blocks.text: Local rules that affect duplexes in Port Moody

items.t: OCP (Port Moody): Port Moody 2050, Official Community Plan Bylaw 2026, No. 3522, adopted April 28, 2026, repealing Bylaw No. 2955 — 2955 is never cited as current.

Zoning / SSMUH (Port Moody): Zoning Bylaw, 2018, No. 2937 puts single detached homes in RS zones and multi-residential homes in RT and RM zones, with mixed-use development in TC and CRM zones at the centre; small-scale multi-unit housing, including coach houses and accessory dwelling units, is permitted in RS and RT zones outside the transit-oriented areas, and the transit-oriented areas are exempt from the SSMUH rules. In June 2024 Council approved Zoning Bylaw Amendment No. 94, 2024, No. 3460 to comply with Bill 44: Up to four dwelling units on lots between 280 m² and 4,050 m², and up to six units on lots in that size band within 400 m of frequent bus stops (15 minutes or less), with minimum parking eliminated in the six-unit case. A Guide to SSMUH was adopted July 22, 2025. Watercourse lots need a riparian assessment and Zoning Bylaw Section 5.4 setbacks, and environmentally sensitive and steep-slope development permit areas can apply on the hillsides. The duplex is the baseline two-unit form inside this framework; SSMUH does not by itself split a duplex into separately titled halves.

The City's guide states suites were permitted in all single detached residential zones in 2004 (except manufactured home parks), extended to the duplex zone in 2018 with the maximum-size restriction removed; the guide's older text also states a suite may not exceed 90 m² and 40% of the building's floor space and may not be stratified — guide text, not a fresh bylaw read; confirm a specific lot against the current consolidated Zoning Bylaw No. 2937.

faq.q: Which part of Port Moody has the most homes for sale?
faq.a: Port Moody Centre, by a wide margin on the attached side: 120 of the community's 192 Condos & Townhomes listings in September 2026, plus 15 detached. North Shore is next for attached (43), and the largest detached shelves are the board-grouped Anmore sub-area (28) and Heritage Woods (18) (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: When are property taxes due in Port Moody?
faq.a: For 2026, City of Port Moody property taxes were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on outstanding amounts after that date and a further 5% after September 15, 2026; utilities are billed separately and the 2026 utility bill was due February 27, 2026.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Port Moody?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 138 houses listed in Port Moody and 13 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 9%. Month-end counts move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: What is the reported sale price for houses in Port Moody?
faq.a: The October report gave $1,529,000 for houses in Port Moody, against $1,685,000 the month before. The reports give one sale-price figure and do not say whether it is an average or a median, so use it for direction, not as a valuation of your own home.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Port Moody?
faq.a: The October report showed 12 days on market for houses in Port Moody and a sale-to-list price ratio of 100%, against 33 days the month before.
